name: All-In-One
description: The All-In-One is the ultimate intergrated Cold Plunge Tub, seamlessly integrating a powerful 1 HP smart chiller within its sleek shell. Enjoy precise, effortless temperature control and a minimalist design. Ideal for stepping or jumping in.
